Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
Our order history for this part shows 28.94 EUR (po:4500010017-10) against 29.89 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is 24.31 EUR (cost:340010).
We had to raise repeated quality notifications on this part this year (qn:20004870, qn:20004967, qn:20004983).
We can work with your lead time of 56 days.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,400 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your historical data and estimates are noted, but our pricing reflects current requirements for sustained quality and supply security. We acknowledge the proposed volume of 23,400 pieces over 24 months, which enables a price adjustment to €31.50 per unit. 

It is our strict corporate policy not to provide internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

Accordingly, our offer is a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your revised offer and the binding volume commitment of 23,400 pieces over 24 months. Management has reviewed the terms, and we can offer a further adjusted price of €31.30 per unit. This represents our best possible pricing under the current market conditions. 

Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.30 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
